description: Structured eval definitions for the CodeArtifact Domain Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across domain topologies (npm domain with external connection and upstream cascade, cross-account repository policy for sharing, VPC endpoint for private access, KMS CMK encryption, missing parent domain prerequisite failure). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: npm domain with external connection and upstream cascade
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — npm domain, internal upstream first, external connection to npmjs.com last, 12-hour auth token expiry noted
eval_cases.prompt: Create a CodeArtifact domain called my-domain in us-east-1, account 123456789012. Create an npm repository my-team-packages within it. Add an upstream to shared-team-packages (internal) and an external connection to npmjs.com. The cascade order must put the internal repo before the public registry. Tags: Environment=production, Team=platform.
eval_cases.expected_output:
CODEARTIFACT_DOMAIN: my-domain (123456789012)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Domain: my-domain — encryption: aws-managed
  [✓] Repository: my-team-packages (format: npm)
  [✓] Upstream cascade: my-team-packages → shared-team-packages → ext:npmjs
  [✓] External connection: npmjs (domain-scoped)
  [✓] Authorization token: aws codeartifact login (12-hour expiry — CI refresh required)
  [✓] Package immutability: enforced
  [✓] Tags: Environment=production, Team=platform
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws codeartifact describe-domain --domain my-domain --region us-east-1
  aws codeartifact describe-repository --domain my-domain --repository my-team-packages --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Cross-account repository policy for read access sharing
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — domain owner grants read access to consumer account via repository policy, consumer login uses domain owner account ID
eval_cases.prompt: Create a CodeArtifact domain shared-artifacts in us-east-1, owner account 123456789012. Create a pip repository data-science-pkgs. Grant read access to consumer account 999999999999 via repository policy. The consumer should use aws codeartifact login with the domain owner account ID. Tags: Environment=production.
eval_cases.expected_output:
CODEARTIFACT_DOMAIN: shared-artifacts (123456789012)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Domain: shared-artifacts — encryption: aws-managed
  [✓] Repository: data-science-pkgs (format: pip)
  [✓] Authorization token: aws codeartifact login (12-hour expiry)
  [✓] Cross-account repository policy: 999999999999 (read)
  [✓] Tags: Environment=production
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws codeartifact describe-domain --domain shared-artifacts --region us-east-1
  aws codeartifact describe-repository --domain shared-artifacts --repository data-science-pkgs --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: VPC interface endpoint for private CodeArtifact access
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — both API and repositories VPC endpoints created, private DNS enabled, dual-endpoint requirement noted
eval_cases.prompt: Create a CodeArtifact domain internal-registry in us-east-1, account 123456789012. Create a maven repository java-artifacts. Set up VPC interface endpoints for private access in VPC vpc-aaa11122, subnets subnet-aaa111 and subnet-bbb222, security group sg-priv-1. Tags: Environment=production, Network=private.
eval_cases.expected_output:
CODEARTIFACT_DOMAIN: internal-registry (123456789012)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Domain: internal-registry — encryption: aws-managed
  [✓] Repository: java-artifacts (format: maven)
  [✓] VPC endpoint: vpce-id (api + repositories, private DNS enabled)
  [✓] Tags: Environment=production, Network=private
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws ec2 describe-vpc-endpoints --filters Name=service-name,Values=com.amazonaws.us-east-1.codeartifact.* --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: CodeArtifact domain with customer-managed KMS encryption key
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — domain created with CMK ARN, encryption immutability noted (cannot change after creation)
eval_cases.prompt: Create a CodeArtifact domain secure-domain in us-east-1, account 123456789012. Use a customer-managed KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd1234-ef56-7890-abcd-ef1234567890 for encryption. Create a nuget repository dotnet-packages. Tags: Environment=production, Compliance=required.
eval_cases.expected_output:
CODEARTIFACT_DOMAIN: secure-domain (123456789012)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Domain: secure-domain — encryption: CMK arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd1234
  [✓] Repository: dotnet-packages (format: nuget)
  [✓] KMS encryption: CMK — immutable at domain creation
  [✓] Tags: Environment=production, Compliance=required
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws codeartifact describe-domain --domain secure-domain --region us-east-1
  aws codeartifact describe-repository --domain secure-domain --repository dotnet-packages --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Repository requested without parent domain existing (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — domain my-domain does not exist; repository creation requires a parent domain
eval_cases.prompt: Create a CodeArtifact repository my-packages in us-east-1, account 123456789012, under domain my-domain. The domain my-domain does not exist yet.
eval_cases.expected_output:
CODEARTIFACT_DOMAIN: my-domain
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] Domain: my-domain — does not exist; repository creation requires a parent domain
